items.title: Nvidia Selloff Puts China Exposed US Chip Stocks Back In Focus
items.summary: A 9.5% two-day slide in Nvidia that wiped about US$430b off its market value has turned a hot AI favorite into a stress test for every large-cap chip stock tied to China. Political scrutiny of Jensen Huang, fresh export-control proposals and a board investigation have pulled risk into sharp focus. This article unpacks how that shock ripples into three U.S. semiconductor stocks exposed to the same headlines and where the news flow currently looks more helpful than harmful. The stocks...
